note: Distribution-side. Upscaled or upsampled sources are refused.
Every HDR delivery must be accompanied by an SDR source at the same resolution with identical conformance and runtime.
Content shot at 23.976, 24 or 25 and telecined to 29.97i must be inverse-telecined back to native.
The Amazon Studios partner portal carries Asset Technical Specifications; the public Prime Video guide is delivery-side only and says nothing about how a shot is named during production.
